facts.text: The Garden State Guarantee provides up to four semesters of free tuition for eligible New Jersey students with an Adjusted Gross Income of $0 to $65,000.

sources.title: Garden State Guarantee - Financial Aid - Ramapo College
sources.quote: The Garden State Guarantee is a state of NJ financial aid program that will provide up to four semesters of free tuition at four-year New Jersey public institutions of higher education
